response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.overall_avg AS margin FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.overall_avg ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10;
